# awscc_workspaces_directory (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::WorkSpaces::Directory



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `active_directory_config` (Attributes) Information about the Active Directory config. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--active_directory_config))
- `alias` (String) The directory alias.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the WorkSpace directory.
- `certificate_based_auth_properties` (Attributes) Describes the properties of the certificate-based authentication you want to use with your WorkSpaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificate_based_auth_properties))
- `customer_user_name` (String) The user name for the service account.
- `directory_id` (String) The directory identifier.
- `directory_name` (String) The name of the directory.
- `directory_type` (String) The directory type.
- `dns_ip_addresses` (List of String) The IP addresses of the DNS servers for the directory.
- `dns_ipv_6_addresses` (List of String) The IPv6 addresses of the DNS servers for the directory.
- `enable_self_service` (Boolean) Indicates whether self-service capabilities are enabled or disabled.
- `endpoint_encryption_mode` (String) Endpoint encryption mode that allows you to configure the specified directory between Standard TLS and FIPS 140-2 validated mode.
- `iam_role_id` (String) The identifier of the IAM role.
- `idc_config` (Attributes) Specifies the configurations of the identity center. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--idc_config))
- `idc_instance_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the identity center instance.
- `ip_group_ids` (List of String) The identifiers of the IP access control groups associated with the directory.
- `microsoft_entra_config` (Attributes) Specifies the configurations of the Microsoft Entra. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--microsoft_entra_config))
- `registration_code` (String) The registration code for the directory.
- `saml_properties` (Attributes) Describes the enablement status, user access URL, and relay state parameter name that are used for configuring federation with an SAML 2.0 identity provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml_properties))
- `selfservice_permissions` (Attributes) Describes the self-service permissions for a directory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--selfservice_permissions))
- `state` (String) The state of the directory's registration with Amazon WorkSpaces.
- `streaming_properties` (Attributes) Describes the streaming properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--streaming_properties))
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) The identifiers of the subnets for your virtual private cloud (VPC).
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags associated with the directory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `tenancy` (String) Indicates whether your WorkSpace directory is dedicated or shared.
- `user_identity_type` (String) The type of identity management the user is using.
- `workspace_access_properties` (Attributes) The device types and operating systems that can be used to access a WorkSpace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_access_properties))
- `workspace_creation_properties` (Attributes) The default values that are used to create WorkSpaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_creation_properties))
- `workspace_directory_description` (String) Description of the directory to register.
- `workspace_directory_name` (String) The name of the directory to register.
- `workspace_security_group_id` (String) The identifier of the security group that is assigned to new WorkSpaces.
- `workspace_type` (String) Indicates whether the directory's WorkSpace type is personal or pools.

<a id="nestedatt--workspace_access_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_access_properties`

Read-Only:

- `access_endpoint_config` (Attributes) Describes the access endpoint configuration for a WorkSpace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_access_properties--access_endpoint_config))
- `device_type_android` (String) Indicates whether users can use Android and Android-compatible Chrome OS devices to access their WorkSpaces.
- `device_type_chrome_os` (String) Indicates whether users can use Chromebooks to access their WorkSpaces.
- `device_type_ios` (String) Indicates whether users can use iOS devices to access their WorkSpaces.
- `device_type_linux` (String) Indicates whether users can use Linux clients to access their WorkSpaces.
- `device_type_osx` (String) Indicates whether users can use macOS clients to access their WorkSpaces.
- `device_type_web` (String) Indicates whether users can access their WorkSpaces through a web browser.
- `device_type_windows` (String) Indicates whether users can use Windows clients to access their WorkSpaces.
- `device_type_work_spaces_thin_client` (String) Indicates whether users can access their WorkSpaces through a WorkSpaces Thin Client.
- `device_type_zero_client` (String) Indicates whether users can use zero client devices to access their WorkSpaces.

<a id="nestedatt--workspace_access_properties--access_endpoint_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_access_properties.access_endpoint_config`

Read-Only:

- `access_endpoints` (Attributes List) Indicates a list of access endpoints associated with this directory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace_access_properties--access_endpoint_config--access_endpoints))
- `internet_fallback_protocols` (List of String) Indicates a list of protocols that fallback to using the public Internet when streaming over a VPC endpoint is not available.

<a id="nestedatt--workspace_access_properties--access_endpoint_config--access_endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_access_properties.access_endpoint_config.access_endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `access_endpoint_type` (String) Indicates the type of access endpoint.
- `vpc_endpoint_id` (String) Indicates the VPC endpoint to use for access.




<a id="nestedatt--workspace_creation_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspace_creation_properties`

Read-Only:

- `custom_security_group_id` (String) The identifier of the default security group to apply to WorkSpaces when they are created.
- `default_ou` (String) The organizational unit (OU) in the directory for the WorkSpace machine accounts.
- `enable_internet_access` (Boolean) Specifies whether to automatically assign an Elastic public IP address to WorkSpaces in this directory by default.
- `enable_maintenance_mode` (Boolean) Specifies whether maintenance mode is enabled for WorkSpaces.
- `instance_iam_role_arn` (String) Indicates the IAM role ARN of the instance.
- `user_enabled_as_local_administrator` (Boolean) Specifies whether WorkSpace users are local administrators on their WorkSpaces.
